mentions.name: Dennis Schroder
mentions.analysis: Dennis Schroder took 16 shots in the season opener, which is unusually high for him. If he continues to get around 13-14 shots and 6 assists, he might be a 15 and 6 guy, which could be valuable.

mentions.name: Grady Dick
mentions.analysis: Grady Dick is a great stream if Immanuel Quickley is out and an adequate stream if Quickley is in.

mentions.name: Trey Mann
mentions.analysis: With Brandon Miller out for at least a week, Trey Mann had a big game in the first one. He should be on head-to-head rosters, but for Roto, a wait-and-see approach is advised.

mentions.name: Dyson Daniels
mentions.analysis: Dyson Daniels had a good game with no Bogdan Bogdanovic around, but it's a sell-high moment as it's unlikely he repeats the performance.

mentions.name: Onyeka Okongwu
mentions.analysis: Onyeka Okongwu had a strong performance, but it's a sell-high moment as it's unlikely he repeats the performance.

mentions.name: Santi Aldama
mentions.analysis: Santi Aldama is a good head-to-head stream option due to the Grizzlies' favorable schedule, but not recommended for Roto.

mentions.name: Rui Hachimura
mentions.analysis: Rui Hachimura is playing well, but his performance has not been seen while Jarred Vanderbilt is healthy. He is considered an injury replacement.

mentions.name: Jordan Hawkins
mentions.analysis: With Dejonte Murray and Trey Murphy out, and possibly Zion Williamson, Jordan Hawkins is worth watching.

mentions.name: Toumani Camara
mentions.analysis: Toumani Camara looked good in the first game and is worth watching to see if he can supplement his performance with rebounds, assists, and steals.

mentions.name: Norman Powell
mentions.analysis: Norman Powell is playing well with two stars out, but historically has not been top 100 when Kawhi Leonard and another star are playing.

mentions.name: Julian Champagnie
mentions.analysis: Julian Champagnie had a well-rounded fantasy game with Devin Vassell out, but needs to show consistency.

mentions.name: Klay Thompson
mentions.analysis: Klay Thompson had a strong performance with seven boards and three steals, but it's unlikely to be repeated.

mentions.name: PJ Washington
mentions.analysis: PJ Washington is expected to be top 100 this year, and it's advised to try to acquire him.
